source.book: 剑桥KET标准版官方真题2（A2 Key 2）

parts.1:
Test Four. There are five parts to the test. You will hear each piece twice. We will now stop for a moment before we start the test. Please ask any questions now because you must NOT speak during the test.
PART 1
Now look at the instructions for Part One.
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Question 1
One. What has Paul bought Timothy for his birthday?
Woman: Hi, Paul. Have you got Timothy the book you wanted to buy for his birthday?
Man: I saw him reading it, so I had to get something else!
Woman: What have you bought?
Man: Well, I thought about a T-shirt or a bag for his sports things. But the bags were a bit too expensive. So I got him something to wear, look!
Woman: He’ll love it!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 2
Two. Where did John go last weekend?
Woman: Hi, John. What did you do last weekend?
Man: Well, I wanted to see the new comedy at the movie theatre, but there weren’t any tickets left.
Woman: Didn’t Bob want you to go to soccer practice with him?
Man: Yes, but he was sick, so I went swimming instead.
Woman: Well, that’s good exercise and you can see the movie another day.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 3
Three. Where’s Sally now?
Man: Hi, Sally. I’m at the bus station, but I can’t see you. Is your bus late?
Woman: Hi. So sorry, I missed the bus and drove into town. I’ve just found a space in the car park and am getting my ticket. Could you walk up the road to the market? I’ll be there in two minutes.
Man: Sure. See you soon.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 4
Four. Which sport is the woman going to do at the sports centre?
Woman: I’d like some information about doing sport here.
Man: Our tennis classes on Wednesday evenings are very popular.
Woman: Oh, that’s no good. I work late on Wednesdays.
Man: What about swimming? The pool’s open every day. We also have a new diving club on Friday evenings.
Woman: Oh, that sounds good. I like swimming, but I’d like to try something new.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 5
Five. What has the woman bought for her new apartment?
Man: I love your new apartment.
Woman: So do I. It’s so much bigger than my old one. There’s lots of space for all my furniture.
Man: I don’t remember that lamp behind the sofa.
Woman: It was in a sale. I got it on my way home yesterday. I might go back to the store – they’ve got some really cheap bookshelves too.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part One.
parts.2:
PART 2
Now look at Part Two.
For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word or a number or a date or a time. Look at questions 6–10 now. You have ten seconds.
You will hear a coach driver telling tourists about their visit to an animal park.
Man: We’ve now arrived at Langate Animal Park. You’ll be here all morning, so you’ll be able to see everything. It might rain, so please take your umbrellas.
This is a popular place with visitors. There are lots of interesting animals, but most people know Langate for the monkeys. There are also over four hundred different kinds of trees from around the world.
I can see you’ve got your cameras – lots of visitors get great pictures by the river. At this time of year, there’s not much to photograph by the lake.
If you’d like to learn more about the park and what lives in it, there’s a talk at ten fifteen by the park guide, and it finishes at ten forty-five.
There’s a lovely café where you can get lunch for only eight pounds ninety-nine, but if you only want a drink, you can get a coffee for two pounds sixty.
The coach will pick you up at one thirty at the entrance called Chepstow – I’ll spell that: C-H-E-P-S-T-O-W. Enjoy your time here!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Two.
parts.3:
PART 3
Now look at Part Three.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 11–15 now. You have twenty seconds.
You will hear two friends, Sophie and John, talking about planning a picnic that they have every year with neighbours.
Man: I can’t wait for this year’s picnic with our neighbours, Sophie!
Woman: And I’m planning it this year, John.
Man: That’ll be easy – everyone loves eating outside.
Woman: Yeah, and it’s how I’ve gotten close to my neighbours. That’s why it’s special.
Man: Cool. Where will we have the picnic this time?
Woman: At the local park – my yard isn’t large enough.
Man: You could have it at the lake?
Woman: It’s too far away.
Man: Everything went well last year!
Woman: Well, it didn’t rain, so that was lucky. But no one came until an hour after the start time!
Man: Right, our neighbour forgot to put his house number on the invitation!
Woman: Yeah, but it was great when we finally found his place.
Man: What should everyone bring?
Woman: I’ve got enough burgers, and forks and stuff.
Man: What about activities?
Woman: Great idea! I’ll ask people to bring games.
Man: How should we tell everyone about the picnic?
Woman: I’ve already emailed most people.
Man: Then you won’t need to go round and tell people about it?
Woman: Right.
Man: But I could put some posters in a few places to make sure everyone knows about it.
Woman: Sure.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Three.
parts.4:
PART 4
Now look at Part Four.
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Question 16
Sixteen. You will hear a woman giving a talk. What’s the woman’s job?
Woman: If you don’t mind spending some of your time outside, then my profession’s something you should consider. Me and my team are building a bridge at the moment – this project might help farmers who’ve got fields on different sides of a river. It’s really beautiful countryside; and very popular with artists, so we don’t want to spoil the view.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 17
Seventeen. You will hear a man talking to his sister about a new friend. Where did the man meet his new friend?
Woman: How was your weekend?
Man: Great! I went cycling with my friend, Paul. I don’t think you know him.
Woman: Is he in your football team?
Man: I don’t think he’s into football. He’s a colleague. He started at the company two months ago.
Woman: Another salesman! Well, invite him to come round here with you on Friday. There’ll be great people, music and lots of food!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 18
Eighteen. You will hear a husband and wife talking about going to the cinema. Why do they decide to walk to the cinema?
Man: Do you still want to go to the cinema this afternoon?
Woman: Sure. The film starts at three – there’s a bus at twenty-five to which should get us there on time. Then I won’t need to use the car.
Man: Why don’t we walk instead? We spend too much time indoors. Let’s get some fresh air.
Woman: OK. We can be healthy for a change!
Man: Yes!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 19
Nineteen. You will hear a man telling a woman about his holiday. What problem did he have on the holiday?
Woman: How was your holiday?
Man: Good, but I’ve slept better since I got back – I won’t miss that loud music every night, my room was above the nightclub! But I’m having trouble getting used to this cold weather now I’m home.
Woman: It’s nice going away somewhere warm in winter.
Man: Yeah. The beach wasn’t like the ones here, which are often covered in rubbish.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 20
Twenty. You will hear a girl talking with her dad about learning a new language. What did the girl like about her first Chinese lesson?
Man: How was your Chinese lesson?
Girl: Well, it was hard work learning a new language for a full hour – about half that time would be better. And I was worried before the lesson started because I didn’t know anyone, but I think everyone felt as nervous as me!
Man: And the teacher?
Girl: She gave us lots of enjoyable exercises that stopped everyone from getting bored!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Four.
parts.5:
PART 5
Now look at Part Five.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 21–25 now. You have fifteen seconds.
You will hear two friends talking about a party on the beach. What will each person bring to the party?
Woman: Are you coming to my beach party on Sunday?
Man: Yeah!
Woman: Ben’s bringing a football – he’s got a new one, so we can have a game before our picnic.
Man: Great! Is Katy bringing anything?
Woman: She’s got a blanket we can use. At first, she wanted to bring a beach umbrella, but they already have them there.
Man: Is Jacob coming?
Woman: Yes, he works for a company which makes sunglasses, so he’s bringing us some – for free! I’ve seen photos of them on their website!
Man: Brilliant!
Woman: And Suzana’s just been on holiday. She got me this cool beach towel as a present. She’s got some pictures to show us at the party.
Man: OK.
Woman: Martin’s bringing some sandwiches and drinks. We can keep them cold under the beach umbrella.
Man: That’s nice. Is Carla coming?
Woman: Yeah, she never misses a trip to the beach! She’s got some great games on her tablet, so we can sit on the blanket and play them.
Man: I think we’ve got everything we need!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Five.
You now have six minutes to write your answers on the answer sheet.
[ping]
You have one more minute.
[ping]
That is the end of the test.

explanations.p1q1: 男士考虑过 T 恤和运动包（"I thought about a T-shirt or a bag for his sports things"），但包 "a bit too expensive"，太贵没买；书 Timothy 已经自己在读了，"I saw him reading it, so I had to get something else!"，所以最终买的是 "something to wear"——一件穿的衣服，对应 A 图，因此选择 A；另两幅图是包和书，都是被排除的选项。
explanations.p1q2: 男士本想去看新喜剧，但 "there weren’t any tickets left"，没去成电影院；Bob 约的足球训练也去不成，因为 "he was sick"，他说 "I went swimming instead"，改成去游泳，因此选择 A（游泳池）；另外两幅图是电影院和足球场。
explanations.p1q3: 萨莉说 "I missed the bus and drove into town"，没赶上公交、自己开车进了城，而且 "I’ve just found a space in the car park and am getting my ticket"，此刻正在停车场取票，因此选择 C（停车场）；在公交站的是男士自己（"I’m at the bus station"），市场只是她约男士走过去碰头的地方（"Could you walk up the road to the market?"），都不是萨莉所在的位置。
explanations.p1q4: 网球课在周三晚上，女士说 "Oh, that’s no good. I work late on Wednesdays."，去不了；她本来就会游泳（"I like swimming"），但 "I’d like to try something new"，男士正好介绍了新项目 "We also have a new diving club on Friday evenings."，所以她要做的是跳水，因此选择 B；另两幅图分别是网球和游泳。
explanations.p1q5: 男士注意到 "I don’t remember that lamp behind the sofa."，女士解释这台灯是昨天回家路上打折买的："It was in a sale. I got it on my way home yesterday."，所以新公寓新买的东西是台灯，因此选择 C；书架只是她打算回头再买（"I might go back to the store – they’ve got some really cheap bookshelves too"），还不算已经买好的东西。
explanations.p2q1: 司机介绍 "There are lots of interesting animals, but most people know Langate for the monkeys."，这个动物公园以猴子闻名，因此填 monkey(s)；园里虽然有 "over four hundred different kinds of trees"，但树只是补充信息，不是公园最出名的东西。
explanations.p2q2: 司机说 "lots of visitors get great pictures by the river"，游客都在河边拍出好照片，因此填 river；他紧接着说 "At this time of year, there’s not much to photograph by the lake."，湖边这个季节没什么可拍，是干扰项。
explanations.p2q3: 司机说 "there’s a talk at ten fifteen by the park guide, and it finishes at ten forty-five."，向导讲解 10:15 开始，因此填 10.15；10:45 是讲解的结束时间，不要误填。
explanations.p2q4: 司机说在咖啡馆 "you can get lunch for only eight pounds ninety-nine"，午餐价格为 8.99，因此填 8.99；后面 "you can get a coffee for two pounds sixty" 是只喝饮料时咖啡的价格，属于干扰信息。
explanations.p2q5: 司机说 "The coach will pick you up at one thirty at the entrance called Chepstow – I’ll spell that: C-H-E-P-S-T-O-W."，大巴接游客的入口名叫 Chepstow，因此填 Chepstow；one thirty（1:30）只是上车时间，别填成地点。
explanations.p3q1: John 觉得野餐很轻松，"everyone loves eating outside"，但 Sophie 说自己最喜欢的是 "it’s how I’ve gotten close to my neighbours. That’s why it’s special."，即野餐让她和邻居们越来越亲近，因此选择 C（becoming better friends with people）；户外吃东西是 John 的说法， spending time outdoors 也不是她强调的重点。
explanations.p3q2: Sophie 定下了地点："At the local park – my yard isn’t large enough."，今年野餐在当地的公园举行，因此选择 A（a park）；John 提议的湖边被 "It’s too far away." 否掉，自家庭院又不够大。
explanations.p3q3: 去年 "it didn’t rain, so that was lucky"，天气其实没问题，A 不对；真正的问题是 "no one came until an hour after the start time!"，因为邻居 "forgot to put his house number on the invitation"，大家不知道去哪儿、晚到了一小时，因此选择 C（Some people didn’t know where to go.）；后来 "it was great when we finally found his place."，并不是有人玩得不开心，B 不对。
explanations.p3q4: 食物和餐具 Sophie 已经备齐："I’ve got enough burgers, and forks and stuff."；John 提议 "What about activities?"，她立刻赞成 "Great idea! I’ll ask people to bring games."，要请大家带的是游戏这类活动，因此选择 A（something to do）；烧烤食物和用餐具都不缺，B、C 不对。
explanations.p3q5: Sophie 说 "I’ve already emailed most people."，群邮件她已经发过，John 不用再发，C 不对；John 问 "Then you won’t need to go round and tell people about it?"，挨家挨户通知也不需要，A 不对；他主动提出 "But I could put some posters in a few places to make sure everyone knows about it."，即去几处贴海报，因此选择 B（put signs in the area）。
explanations.p4q1: 这位女士说 "Me and my team are building a bridge at the moment"，她的团队正在建桥，职业是工程师，因此选择 A（engineer）；农民是桥梁项目要帮助的对象（"might help farmers who’ve got fields on different sides of a river"），画家是爱来画这片风景的人（"very popular with artists, so we don’t want to spoil the view"），都不是她的职业。
explanations.p4q2: 男士说新朋友 "He’s a colleague. He started at the company two months ago."，是两个月前入职的同事，两人是在工作中认识的，因此选择 A（at work）；他并不踢足球（"I don’t think he’s into football"），周五的聚会只是姐姐邀请他带朋友来家里（"invite him to come round here with you on Friday"），都不是认识新朋友的地方。
explanations.p4q3: 男士提议走路："Why don’t we walk instead? We spend too much time indoors. Let’s get some fresh air."，女士也同意 "OK. We can be healthy for a change!"，两人想锻炼身体、呼吸新鲜空气，因此选择 B（They want some exercise.）；三点前有 "a bus at twenty-five to" 可以坐，今天并非没有公交，A 不对；女士只是说坐车就不用开车（"Then I won’t need to use the car"），车并没有坏，C 不对。
explanations.p4q4: 男士说 "I won’t miss that loud music every night, my room was above the nightclub!"，房间在夜店楼上、夜夜吵得睡不好，因此选择 C（The hotel was noisy.）；假期去的是 "somewhere warm in winter"，怕冷是回家之后的事（"now I’m home"），A 不对；常被垃圾覆盖（"often covered in rubbish"）的是本地海滩，度假的海滩并不一样，B 不对。
explanations.p4q5: 女孩夸老师 "She gave us lots of enjoyable exercises that stopped everyone from getting bored!"，让大家不无聊的有趣练习都来自老师，她喜欢的是老师，因此选择 B（the teacher）；同学是课前一个都不认识（"I didn’t know anyone"），时长是一整小时、她觉得 "about half that time would be better"，A、C 都是她的抱怨而非满意之处。
explanations.p5q1: 问到 Katy，女士说 "She’s got a blanket we can use."，Katy 带的是毯子，因此选 B（blanket）；沙滩伞她本来想带，"but they already have them there"，那边已经有了，不用带。
explanations.p5q2: Jacob 在 "a company which makes sunglasses" 工作，"so he’s bringing us some – for free!"，他会带太阳镜来，因此选 G（sunglasses）；"I’ve seen photos of them on their website!" 只是女士看过官网上的照片，不是他要带照片来。
explanations.p5q3: Suzana 度假回来送了女士礼物："got me this cool beach towel as a present"，沙滩巾不是她带去派对的；她 "She’s got some pictures to show us at the party."，要带的是度假照片给大家看，因此选 E（photos）。
explanations.p5q4: 女士说 "Martin’s bringing some sandwiches and drinks."，Martin 带三明治和饮料，即野餐食物，因此选 F（picnic）；"We can keep them cold under the beach umbrella." 只说明伞是现成的，与他无关。
explanations.p5q5: Carla "She’s got some great games on her tablet"，会带平板上的游戏来玩，因此选 D（games）；"we can sit on the blanket and play them" 里坐的毯子是 Katy 带的，别混淆。
